trigger: Annie's seed-and-book swap table by the registry hall doors (trader).

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: A folding table: SEED LIBRARY. TAKE ONE, BRING ONE. A woman in a sun hat behind it, misting seedlings.

nodes.speaker: trader_annie
nodes.text: Hello. I'm Annie, Sparks branch. Well, I was. I'm still. The library didn't close, the building did.

nodes.speaker: trader_annie
nodes.text: Seeds, a few books, some antibiotics a vet donated. I trade for batteries, wire, glass. Or labor.

choices.text: What do you need labor for?

nodes.speaker: trader_annie
nodes.text: Thank you. Use them on someone who'll argue with you about it. Those ones live.

nodes.speaker: trader_annie
nodes.text: Somebody will, next spring. That's the whole idea of a library, really.

nodes.speaker: trader_annie
nodes.text: The library has a glass atrium. If anyone ever gets power again, it's a greenhouse. Think about it.

nodes.speaker: trader_annie
nodes.text: Come by the branch on Pyramid Way when you can. Bring a story. I'm collecting those too.
